description: We are Team Nepton, a multidisciplinary tech team participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge (Shibin El-Kom). We are building an intelligent, early-warning dashboard for wildfires by harmonizing MODIS and VIIRS satellite data
summary:
Nepton is an advanced 3D geospatial platform for real-time and historical wildfire monitoring (2018–2026), built for the NASA Space Apps Challenge.

Core Architecture: Utilizes multi-level Spatial Grids (LOD) and CesiumJS GPU-accelerated GroundPrimitive rendering to handle thousands of active cells at 60 FPS, paired with 300ms camera debounce and atomic-swap zero-flicker transitions.

Key Features: Includes an interactive 5-tier risk calendar heatmap, flexible temporal filters, and a Groq AI chat assistant.

Competitive Edge: Unmatched 3D rendering performance, precise spatial data optimization, and full mobile responsiveness.

Future Scope: While the platform is fully functional, an advanced AI Predictive Model was designed for forecasting future wildfire spread, but its live UI integration was omitted due to strict hackathon time constraints.
details:
Project Overview: Nepton

  • Mission: An advanced 3D geospatial intelligence platform designed for real-time and historical wildfire monitoring (spanning from 2018 to 2026).
  • Theme & Aesthetic: Comic-book sci-fi retro vibe, featuring cosmic dark space backgrounds, neon highlights, and pop-art vector elements.

🛠️ Core Technical Architecture

  • Spatial Grid Aggregation (LOD): Implements a multi-level grid system (100km, 50km, 10km resolutions) that dynamically groups data based on the viewport bounding box, sending only active, sparse fire cells to minimize payload size.
    • 300ms Camera Debounce to prevent network spam during map movement.
    • AbortController to cancel stale fetch requests instantly.
    • Zero-Flicker Atomic Swaps that keep old layers visible until new geometries are fully ready.

📊 Key Features & User Interface

  • Interactive 3D Globe: Smooth navigation powered by CesiumJS with custom OpenStreetMap integration.
  • Temporal Fire Calendar Heatmap: A 5-tier risk color-coded matrix (ranging from zero/none to critical red) allowing users to click any date to filter active fires instantly.
  • Flexible Timeline Bar: Toggle between single-year detailed views and an "All Years (2018–2026)" macro-view.
  • Nepton AI Assistant: Integrated via the Groq API (llama models) to answer real-time telemetry and wildfire impact questions.
  • Click-to-Inspect Tooltips: Dynamic popups displaying detailed cell metrics (Hotspot counts, Total FRP, Average FRP, and Density).
  • Fully Responsive UI: Polished mobile, tablet, and desktop layouts with collapsible control drawers.

🔮 Future Roadmap & AI Integration

  • Predictive ML Model: An advanced machine learning model was specifically designed for forecasting future wildfire spread patterns.
  • Hackathon Status: While the core visualization engine, UI, and tools are fully operational, live UI integration of the predictive model was omitted due to strict hackathon time constraints, making it the primary focus for future scaling.
